entities.summary: Gennadiy Bogolyubov is a Ukrainian oligarch based in the United Kingdom. He controlled Privat Group, along with Ihor Kolomoyskyi and Oleksiy Martynov. Gennadiy Bogolyubov was a performers & entertainers from Kamyanske (b. 1962-01-20, Kamyanske). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
